intro: Milos recliner is all about making relaxation natural. We paired a no-fuss push-back design with cream leatherette and resilient foam for simple, soothing comfort.

features.title: Recline with a gentle push
features.text: Our recliner’s manual push-back mechanism needs no levers or buttons—just lean back and let the chair move with you. It adjusts up to 135°, offering you quiet, seamless control over your comfort.

features.title: Soothe your spine, anytime
features.text: An inbuilt lumbar massager, powered by remote, provides 8 vibration settings to melt away tension. It’s your personal retreat after a long day—at the press of a button.

features.title: Support that lifts, not just leans
features.text: The high backrest is shaped to embrace your head, shoulders, and spine—giving your body a gentle reminder to breathe, rest, and reset.

features.title: Made to feel luxurious, yet easy
features.text: Wrapped in soft synthetic leather, our recliner feels refined and stays low maintenance. It resists stains and wear, so you can relax without worry.

features.title: Solid support, subtle style
features.text: PVC legs keep the recliner grounded and lifted just enough for easy floor cleaning. Sturdy and discreet, they’re designed to blend into your space beautifully.

features.title: Armrests shaped for ease and elegance
features.text: Our recliner’s sleek, rounded armrests are thoughtfully contoured to follow the natural curve of your arms. They support you in all the right ways—offering both ergonomic comfort and a refined silhouette that adds softness and style to any space.

name: Milos 1-Seater Synthetic Leather Manual Recliner Sofa With Massager
